page: Microsoft Azure HB368-240rs_v5 is a compute-focused instance belonging to the HBv5 server family. It is equipped with 240 dedicated x86_64 vCPUs powered by an Intel processor and managed via the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The system features 448.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 1.87 GB of RAM per core.

For storage-intensive operations, the instance includes 15,851 GB of local NVMe SSD storage and is compatible with Azure Premium Storage. It also features Remote Direct Memory Access capabilities, enabling low-latency, high-throughput inter-node communication across clustered environments. There are no integrated GPUs on this server type.

Given the high physical core count relative to the memory allocation, this instance offers a specialized hardware profile optimized for raw compute density rather than massive memory-per-core ratios. The inclusion of substantial local NVMe storage and RDMA networking makes it highly efficient for large-scale distributed simulations, high-performance computing workloads, clustered database deployments, and intensive parallel processing tasks that require rapid local scratch space.
